title: Barcelona Babylab Network
text:
The Barcelona Babylab Network (BCN-BN) is a community of researchers in the Metropolitan Area of Barcelona dedicated to studying infant development and cognition. We aim to promote collaborations between different research groups, bringing together researchers, practitioners, and institutions in the area of Barcelona and beyond.




We meet approximately every two months to share our work, talk about initiatives and learn together. BCN-BN seminars are held in person (online option is sometimes possible depending on logistics), hosted by one of the member institutions.

title: About Us
text:
The Barcelona Babylab Network (BCN-BN) is a collaborative research community based in Barcelona, dedicated to advancing our understanding of infant development and cognition. We bring together researchers, clinicians, and institutions to conduct rigorous, innovative research on how babies learn and develop.
The BCN-BN is an initiative led by postdoctoral researchers Konstantina Zacharaki (Universitat de Barcelona) and Gonzalo García-Castro (Institut de Recerca Sant Joan de Déu, IRSJD), with the support of their respective research groups, Brain Mechanisms of Language Learning (PI Ruth de Diego Balaguer) and Neurodevelopment and Comparative Cognition (PI Chiara Santolin).


Interested in Joining?
If you’re a researcher interested in infant development and would like to connect with our network, please get in touch at gonzalo.garcia@sjd.es or k.zacharaki@ub.edu.
